title: Genome-wide guide-site-aware CRISPRa targetability dataset and prioritization framework for murine microglial ATAC-seq contexts
description: Versioned source, workflow, validation outputs, figures, supplementary tables, derived ATAC-seq peak and signal artifacts, and reference-input checksums supporting a genome-wide murine microglial CRISPRa guide-site targetability dataset and prioritization framework. The resource integrates promoter PAM availability with ATAC-seq peak support for complete protospacer-PAM intervals and is intended for hypothesis generation and experimental prioritization, not functional CRISPRa validation.
